# TypeScript Guidelines

## Type Safety

Use strict typing.

Avoid using any.

Prefer unknown when appropriate.

## Interfaces

Define contracts using interfaces.

Program against abstractions.

## Types

Use reusable types.

Avoid duplicated type definitions.

## Generics

Use generics where they improve flexibility.

Do not overuse generics.

## Null Safety

Handle undefined and null explicitly.

Avoid unsafe assertions.

## Exports

Export only what is required.

Keep internal types private.

## Async

Use async/await.

Handle promise failures.

Avoid unhandled promises.
